name: jeecgboot/JeecgBoot
summary: 项目将其描述为面向业务系统的 AI 低代码平台，可辅助生成数据库表、应用代码、表单和工作流，并提供构建 AI 聊天和知识库应用的工具。

The project describes an AI-assisted low-code platform for building business applications. It lists generation of database tables, application code, forms, and workflows, alongside tools for building AI chat and knowledge-base applications.
